changelog: ONT-WGS type strains: (1) fix — when only 2 type strains fall within ANI range (e.g. Priestia megaterium), FastME (needs ≥ 4 genomes) wrote an empty tree and the whole type-strain section was lost ('string index out of range'); small trees now use neighbour joining, and a tree failure no longer removes the ANI table. (2) When other type strains are also ≥ 95 % (B. cereus / B. thuringiensis, Geobacillus zalihae / thermoleovorans / kaustophilus / vulcani, P. megaterium / aryabhattai) the verdict names them and says ANI cannot separate those species. (3) Strain labels: no doubled type mark (BCT-7112TT, KCTC3922(T)T), no 'T' after an empty strain, serovar entries of the same type strain merged (B. thuringiensis serovar berliner ATCC 10792 listed once). Re-analyse to apply.

previous.changelog: ONT-WGS Re-analyse is much faster: sourmash/GTDB (≈ 8 min per sample — the 3.6 GB index is read on one core), CheckM2, Bakta and the reference mapping keep their results in the job's work folder, keyed by the assembly checksum, database and options, and reuse them when nothing changed (the log says 'reusing … results'). Results are identical; any change to the assembly, database or settings recomputes. No restart needed for running jobs; takes effect from the next run.
